name: Chiswick
lede: Chiswick in Woollahra is a relaxed Sydney restaurant with dining inside and out. Tungsten gas heaters keep a table on the terrace as inviting on a cool evening as one indoors.
beats: A relaxed restaurant from a well-known chef, with dining inside and on the terrace, a bar, a long communal table and shaded outdoor seating.
Diners outside had to be as comfortable as those indoors on cool Sydney evenings.
Tungsten Smart-Heat Gas heaters were chosen to keep diners comfortable wherever they sit, the terrace included. The quantity and mounting are to confirm.
